boundaries.cli: Actual PROCESS/stdout.bin/stderr.bin; process creation through reap, excludes QA wrapper publication
boundaries.public: Broker reserved consumer calls; operator close separate; host tool calls are not provider requests
boundaries.worker: Actual worker RPCs attributed by monotone broker intervals; product capture included, not a separate public call
boundaries.bytes: Code/arguments/request are overlapping representations; do not add them
boundaries.timing: CLI, thin helper, broker, service, worker and chain wall are nested; do not sum layers
boundaries.model: MODEL_USAGE numeric cumulative anchors only. Model-consumed tool bytes, provider count and fees unmeasured
boundaries.preparation: Root process records and two qualification records are retained separately; included in whole task time, not added to nested consumer costs
